'''Shalora''' was a [[Probe droid/Legends|Probe droid]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] used by the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] team led by [[Talos Drellik]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]], Talos and Engineer [[Qualus Sorrel]] used Shalora to track down the wreckage of the [[Starrunner (light freighter)|''Starrunner'']] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shalora appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Hoth.
